## One-sentence summary
Amr Magdy builds the Salesforce systems US real estate investors and wholesalers run on. His point
of view: most investors don't have a lead problem, they have a leak problem ("Deal Leak"): money
disappears between the marketing dollar and the kept deal at five points a CRM can measure (Spend,
Answer, Follow-up, Offer, Keep), described in his Kept-Deal Map: https://amrmagdy.com/kept-deal-map.html

## Current focus (October 2026)
- Who he works with: real estate investors, home-buying companies and wholesalers in the United States first, and in Canada and Europe (including the UK).
- What he builds: the Salesforce system a home-buying company runs on, from marketing campaign to closed deal: campaign ROI by market, speed to lead, missed-call alerts, shared lead queues, underwriting on the opportunity, a transactions board, RingCentral call sync, DocuSign alerts and a no-code rules engine.
- Proof: for the last two years he has built and run the Salesforce org behind Central City Solutions, a home-buying company in Columbus, Ohio.
- Working hours: afternoons and evenings Cairo time, which covers US mornings and the full Gulf business day.

## Services and prices
- CRM Revenue Audit: fixed price USD 1,500, for teams already on Salesforce. Teams on Podio, REsimpli, GoHighLevel or other CRMs are offered a move to Salesforce instead (https://amrmagdy.com/move-to-salesforce.html). A review of an investor CRM covering campaign ROI, speed to lead, acquisitions follow-up, data health, automations and reporting. Deliverables: findings report, 30/60/90-day roadmap, a "Monday 5" dashboard spec and three quick fixes done. Page: https://amrmagdy.com/crm-revenue-audit.html. Sample report (made-up company): https://amrmagdy.com/sample-audit-report.html
- Full Salesforce implementation for investors and wholesalers (project-based), including moving teams from Podio, REsimpli or GoHighLevel to Salesforce.
- Ongoing CRM support and development (monthly retainer). The most popular engagement.
- Free 30-minute call to start: info@AmrMagdy.com or https://www.linkedin.com/in/amrmagdyai

## The Monday 5 (the five numbers he recommends an investor owner reviews every week)
1. Cost per appointment by marketing campaign
2. Contracts per campaign
3. Time from contract to first seller call
4. Booked revenue forecast vs actual
5. ROI that only counts deals that actually closed (kept deals)
